title: Recovery
summary: Storage recovery and testing. Rescue a failing storage device, test a device before you trust it, and copy and pack files. The toolkit has ddrescue, testdisk, f3 and smartmontools.
consent: These tools read and write raw storage. ddrescue and testdisk can overwrite a disk if you select the wrong destination. The overwrite cannot be undone. Read their prompts. Install the toolkit only while you need it.
notes: A box without internet cannot download these tools when the card starts to fail. Keep the toolkit in the cache (System → Toolkits). Then you can install it from the cache.

f3write and f3read show if a storage device is fake or failing. The time depends on the size and the hardware. Name the source and the destination before you start ddrescue. ddrescue copies the data that a failing device still gives into an image. You can write the image to a new device.
smartctl reads SMART data from USB disks that report it. SD cards do not report SMART data.
